secrets.name: AI_BASE_URL
secrets.description: OpenAI-compatible provider base URL (e.g. https://api.openai.com/v1). Optional — AI features return 503 without it.

secrets.name: AI_API_KEY
secrets.description: API key for the AI provider. Optional — AI features return 503 without it.

secrets.name: AI_MODEL
secrets.description: Model name to use with the AI provider (e.g. gpt-4o). Optional.

secrets.name: BASE44_API_URL
secrets.description: Base44 API URL for server-side integration. Optional.

secrets.name: BASE44_API_KEY
secrets.description: Base44 API key for server-side calls. Optional.

secrets.name: STORAGE_ENDPOINT
secrets.description: S3-compatible storage endpoint URL. Optional — file uploads disabled without it.

secrets.name: TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudflare Turnstile secret key for verification. Optional.

secrets.name: CRYSTAL_API_KEY
secrets.description: Bearer token protecting /api/v1 and /api/ai routes. Optional — routes are open without it.
